title: U Cutout Color
description: Make the lower border of the u cutout between the two chips have the same color as the chips
summary:
Implemented correct U cutout border color for chips in the print LaTeX system.

The lower border of the U-shaped cutout between two stacked chips (inside \semio@window@gap in print/semio-window.sty) now correctly inherits the chip color (e.g., primary, secondary, tertiary) instead of always using the default chrome border color. For chips without a window above them (e.g., paragraphs chips at the bottom), the border is still drawn using semio-chrome-border-normal.

Files worked on:
- print/semio-window.sty — Modified \semio@window@gap to accept a bordercolor argument and updated \semio@heading@pair to pass the chip accent color; updated \semio@heading@pair@muted variants to use semio-chrome-border-normal.
